tier1.headline: Your data shared commercially
tier1.quote: We may share information with private organizations as part of a service that provides NASA.gov users with increased capabilities or functionality on the site.

tier1.headline: Your data trains AI
tier1.quote: Electronic communications with NASA may be scanned by government-owned or contractor equipment to look for network traffic indicating known or suspected malicious cyber activity, including malicious content or communications.

tier1.headline: Your data collected without account
tier1.quote: Third parties may collect information on visitors who share NASA content on their Facebook pages, Twitter feeds or other social media/networking sites.

tier2.headline: Your data shared broadly
tier2.quote: NASA will only share your information with another government agency if it relates to that agency, or as otherwise required by law.

tier2.headline: Your data retained indefinitely
tier2.quote: Raw data logs are retained temporarily as required for security and site management purposes only.

tier2.headline: Your behavior creates profiles
tier2.quote: This demographic information is used to help us better understand our visitors’ interests and needs to more effectively develop content to serve you.

tier2.headline: Your data transferred globally
tier2.quote: Electronic communications within NASA will be collected or retained by US-CERT only if they are associated with known or suspected cyber threats.

tier2.headline: Your data shared with law enforcement
tier2.quote: If such monitoring reveals evidence of possible abuse or criminal activity, such evidence may be provided to appropriate law enforcement officials.

tier2.headline: Your deletion rights are limited
tier2.quote: On rare occasions, it may be determined that a communication from a child under 13 years old should be maintained for historical purposes.
